title.narrative: Livelihood, Youth Employment and Placement Accelerator (LiYEPA)

description.narrative: Liberia is undergoing a complex demographic, economic, and technological transition that presents both significant risks and compelling opportunities for accelerated national development. With an estimated population of 5.61 million in 2024 and more than 60 percent under the age of 35, the country holds a powerful demographic dividend capable of driving long-term prosperity if properly harnessed. However, this potential remains largely unrealized due to persistent structural constraints, including limited access to digital tools and skills, high levels of informal and precarious employment, low entrepreneurial capabilities, and deepening climate vulnerabilities that undermine livelihoods and social cohesion.Approximately 79 percent of the labor force is self-employed, and more than 86 percent works in the informal sector, highlighting the prevalence of unstable, low-income livelihood activities that offer limited security or upward mobility for young people. These trends disproportionately affect women and persons with disabilities, who face additional barriers to economic participation due to entrenched gender norms, limited access to productive assets, and inadequate support systems.Digital exclusion further widens these socioeconomic disparities. Despite ongoing government investments in digital transformation, Liberia continues to face significant technological and infrastructural gaps. Digital literacy remains low across much of the population, connectivity is uneven, and many public service systems still operate manually. These limitations constrain access to digital learning and employment opportunities and restrict the ability of vulnerable groups, especially women’s groups and persons with disabilities to participate in the digital economy. Consequently, youth struggle to access emerging online jobs and entrepreneurial opportunities, while women-led enterprises and start-ups remain underrepresented within digital innovation ecosystems.
